name: bambu-printer-mcp

tools.name: get_printer_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the Bambu Lab printer

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the printer (default: value from env)

bambu_serial.description: Serial number for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

bambu_token.description: Access token for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: get_printer_filaments
tools.description: Get the live AMS/external filament inventory from the printer over MQTT, including loaded/empty slot summary, resolved slicer profile paths, match confidence, and recommended load_filaments when the printer model is known.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the printer (default: value from env)

bambu_serial.description: Serial number for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

bambu_token.description: Access token for the Bambu Lab printer (default: value from env)

bambu_model.description: Optional model hint used to resolve Bambu/Orca filament profile JSONs for each tray.

nozzle_diameter.description: Optional nozzle diameter used when resolving model-specific filament profile JSONs (default: 0.4).

tools.name: resolve_3mf_ams_slots
tools.description: Inspect a sliced 3MF and match its tray_info_idx filament requirements against the live AMS inventory. Does not upload or start a print.

bambu_model.description: Optional model hint used to resolve Bambu/Orca filament profile JSONs for each tray.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: list_3mf_plate_objects
tools.description: List object IDs from a sliced 3MF plate. Use these IDs with skip_objects during a running print.

tools.name: extend_stl_base
tools.description: Extend the base of an STL file by a specified amount

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to modify

extension_height.description: Height in mm to extend the base by

tools.name: scale_stl
tools.description: Scale an STL file by specified factors

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to scale

tools.name: rotate_stl
tools.description: Rotate an STL file by specified angles (degrees)

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to rotate

angle_x.description: Rotation angle for X axis in degrees (default: 0)

angle_y.description: Rotation angle for Y axis in degrees (default: 0)

angle_z.description: Rotation angle for Z axis in degrees (default: 0)

tools.name: get_stl_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about an STL file (bounding box, face count, dimensions)

stl_path.description: Path to the STL file to analyze

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List saved slicing templates from the local template registry directory.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override. Defaults to BAMBU_TEMPLATE_DIR or the server's configured local template registry.

tools.name: save_template
tools.description: Copy a 3MF, JSON, or config file into the local template registry and register it under a template name.

source_path.description: Path to a local .3mf, .json, or .config file to save into the template registry.

template_name.description: Optional template name. Defaults to the source filename without extension.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override. Defaults to BAMBU_TEMPLATE_DIR or the server's configured local template registry.

tools.name: get_slice_settings
tools.description: Inspect slicer settings from a saved 3MF template or a JSON/config slicer profile without slicing anything. For a 3MF given as source_path, own_process is true when slice_stl, given this call's other arguments as it would take them (slicer_profile, template_name, template_3mf_path, layer_height, wall_loops, sparse_infill_density, quality, strength), prints the process the file carries (a designer's Bambu Studio or Orca project) unchanged. A 3MF with no slicer settings reports raw_key_count 0; a file that can't be read is an error.

source_path.description: Path to a 3MF template, extracted project_settings.config, or slicer profile JSON.

template_name.description: Optional named template from the local registry. Without source_path it is the source read; with source_path it is the slice's template, for own_process.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override when resolving template_name.

slicer_profile.description: For own_process: the slicer_profile slice_stl would be given.

template_3mf_path.description: For own_process: the template_3mf_path slice_stl would be given.

layer_height.description: For own_process: the layer_height slice_stl would be given.

nozzle_diameter.description: For own_process: the nozzle_diameter slice_stl would be given; layer heights are checked against it.

wall_loops.description: For own_process: the wall_loops slice_stl would be given.

sparse_infill_density.description: For own_process: the sparse_infill_density slice_stl would be given.

enable_support.description: For own_process: the enable_support slice_stl would be given.

support_type.description: For own_process: the support_type slice_stl would be given.

quality.description: Print quality: draft (thicker layers, faster), standard (the preset's own layer height) or fine (thinner layers). The server picks the layer height for the nozzle in use; an explicit layer_height wins.

strength.description: Part strength: standard (the process's own walls and infill), strong or max (at least more walls and denser infill; a process that already has more keeps it). The server picks the values; explicit wall_loops or sparse_infill_density win.

tools.name: slice_with_template
tools.description: Slice an STL or 3MF using a named template from the local registry. This is a higher-level wrapper around slice_stl for template-based workflows.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL or 3MF file to slice

template_name.description: Named template from the local registry.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override when resolving template_name.

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Using the wrong model can damage the printer.

slicer_type.description: Type of slicer to use. Bambu-compatible choices (bambustudio, orcaslicer, orcaslicer-bambulab) export sliced 3MF; aliases such as fulu-orca and orca-studio are accepted.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable (default: value from env). Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Explicit slicer profile/config file. Overrides the named template only when provided in the tool call.

bed_type.description: Bed plate type for slicing (default: textured_plate). SuperTack is accepted only for pre-sliced print jobs until the BambuStudio CLI identifier is verified.

nozzle_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: the hotend nozzle material installed on the printer (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the model preset's stock nozzle, usually stainless_steel). Printing compares it with the printer's reported nozzle.

nozzle_volume_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: the flow type of the nozzle installed on the printer (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_VOLUME_TYPE, else standard). high_flow uses the presets' High Flow values, such as the filament's High Flow max volumetric speed, and is refused if the machine preset has no High Flow variant. Printing compares it with the printer's reported nozzle flow.

use_printer_filaments.description: When true, and no explicit slicer profile or load_filaments override is provided, use the printer's current or first loaded AMS filament as the slicer filament profile.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

load_filaments.description: Override filament profiles. Semicolon-separated paths to filament JSON configs.

filament_colours.description: Optional slot colours, one #RRGGBB per filament slot in order, separated by ';' (e.g. '#161616;#FFFFFF'). Defaults to the input 3MF's project colours, else the BambuStudio default.

ensure_on_bed.description: Lift floating models onto the bed.

arrange.description: Auto-arrange objects on the build plate.

repetitions.description: Total copies of an STL, using clone_objects internally. Do not also pass clone_objects. The slicer may place copies on multiple plates; print_3mf prints one selected plate per call. For 3MF input, select slice_plate explicitly.

skip_modified_gcodes.description: Ignore stale custom gcodes in the 3MF.

pause_at_layers.description: Pause before each of these layers (1-based, as Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer number them in the preview), for example to drop in magnets or nuts. The slicer writes the printer's own pause G-code there (M400 U1 on Bambu printers); the printer stops by itself and waits for Resume. Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer CLI only. Pauses already in a project 3MF are kept.

slice_plate.description: Which plate index to slice. 0 = all plates.

tools.name: slice_stl
tools.description: Slice an STL or 3MF file using a slicer to generate printable G-code or sliced 3MF. IMPORTANT: bambu_model must be specified to ensure the slicer generates safe G-code for the correct printer. The text result is the sliced file's path. When Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer writes a result.json, structuredContent.slicer_result carries it verbatim, success or error: error_string, return_code and each sliced_plates[].warning_message, such as a floating cantilever. A failed slice's text starts with those words. A 3MF that carries its own process settings (a designer's Bambu Studio or Orca project) slices with them unless slicer_profile, template_name or template_3mf_path is given; the machine still comes from bambu_model. quality and strength adjust that process, and strength never lowers its walls or infill.

stl_path.description: Path to the STL or 3MF file to slice

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Using the wrong model can damage the printer.

slicer_type.description: Type of slicer to use. Bambu-compatible choices (bambustudio, orcaslicer, orcaslicer-bambulab) export sliced 3MF; aliases such as fulu-orca and orca-studio are accepted.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable (default: value from env). Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Path to an optional process profile/config file. The exact bambu_model/nozzle machine preset is still required.

template_3mf_path.description: Optional template 3MF whose embedded Bambu slicer settings should be reused when slicing a new STL or 3MF.

template_name.description: Optional named template from the local registry. Resolves to template_3mf_path automatically.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override when resolving template_name.

bed_type.description: Bed plate type for slicing (default: textured_plate). SuperTack is accepted only for pre-sliced print jobs until the BambuStudio CLI identifier is verified.

nozzle_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: the hotend nozzle material installed on the printer (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the model preset's stock nozzle, usually stainless_steel). Printing compares it with the printer's reported nozzle.

nozzle_volume_type.description: Bambu-compatible slicing: the flow type of the nozzle installed on the printer (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_VOLUME_TYPE, else standard). high_flow uses the presets' High Flow values, such as the filament's High Flow max volumetric speed, and is refused if the machine preset has no High Flow variant. Printing compares it with the printer's reported nozzle flow.

use_printer_filaments.description: When true, and no explicit slicer profile or load_filaments override is provided, use the printer's current or first loaded AMS filament as the slicer filament profile. Template 3MF process settings can still be used at the same time.

uptodate.description: Refresh 3MF preset configs to match the latest BambuStudio version. Use when slicing downloaded or older 3MF files to prevent stale-config failures.

repetitions.description: Slice N identical copies of the model. Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer copy an STL with --clone-objects; do not also pass clone_objects. Copies may need multiple plates; print_3mf prints one selected plate per call. For 3MF input, select slice_plate explicitly.

orient.description: Auto-orient the model for optimal printability (minimize supports, maximize bed adhesion). Recommended for raw STL imports that lack a pre-set orientation.

arrange.description: Auto-arrange all objects on the build plate with optimal spacing; STL input is arranged by default. Set false only to keep a 3MF's existing layout: an STL that is not already on the plate then fails to slice.

ensure_on_bed.description: Detect models floating above the bed and lower them onto the build surface. Safety net for imported models with incorrect Z origins.

clone_objects.description: Clone the loaded model: total copies as a single integer, e.g. '3'. The Bambu-style CLIs count copies per input file and this tool loads one file, so a comma-separated list is rejected by the slicer.

skip_objects.description: Skip specific objects during slicing by index. Comma-separated, e.g. '3,5,10'. Useful for multi-object 3MFs where you only want to print some parts.

load_filaments.description: Override filament profiles. Semicolon-separated paths to filament JSON configs, e.g. 'pla_basic.json;petg_cf.json'.

filament_profile.description: Compatibility alias for load_filaments. Semicolon-separated Orca/Bambu filament profile JSON paths.

load_filament_ids.description: Map filaments to objects/parts. Comma-separated IDs matching load_filaments order, e.g. '1,2,3,1' assigns filament 1 to objects 0 and 3.

filament_colours.description: Optional slot colours, one #RRGGBB per filament slot in order, separated by ';' (e.g. '#161616;#FFFFFF'). Defaults to the input 3MF's project colours, else the BambuStudio default.

enable_timelapse.description: Insert timelapse parking moves into gcode. The toolhead parks at a fixed position each layer for camera capture. Adds ~10% print time.

allow_mix_temp.description: Allow filaments with different temperature requirements on the same plate. Required for multi-material prints mixing e.g. PLA and PETG.

scale.description: Uniform scale factor applied to all axes. 1.0 = original size, 2.0 = double, 0.5 = half. Applied before slicing.

rotate.description: Rotate the model around the Z-axis (vertical) by this many degrees before slicing. Positive = counterclockwise when viewed from above.

rotate_x.description: Rotate the model around the X-axis by this many degrees before slicing. Useful for reorienting prints for better layer adhesion.

rotate_y.description: Rotate the model around the Y-axis by this many degrees before slicing. Useful for reorienting prints for better layer adhesion.

min_save.description: Write a smaller output 3MF by omitting non-essential metadata. Reduces file size for faster FTP upload to the printer.

skip_modified_gcodes.description: Strip custom start/end gcodes embedded in the 3MF. Recommended for downloaded 3MFs since custom gcodes from other users' profiles may be unsafe for your printer.

pause_at_layers.description: Pause before each of these layers (1-based, as Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer number them in the preview), for example to drop in magnets or nuts. The slicer writes the printer's own pause G-code there (M400 U1 on Bambu printers); the printer stops by itself and waits for Resume. Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer CLI only. Pauses already in a project 3MF are kept.

slice_plate.description: Which plate index to slice. 0 = all plates for local slicers; remote slicing defaults to plate 1 and rejects 0. Use 1, 2, etc. to slice only a specific plate in multi-plate 3MF projects.

quality.description: Print quality: draft (thicker layers, faster), standard (the preset's own layer height) or fine (thinner layers). The server picks the layer height for the nozzle in use; an explicit layer_height wins.

strength.description: Part strength: standard (the process's own walls and infill), strong or max (at least more walls and denser infill; a process that already has more keeps it). The server picks the values; explicit wall_loops or sparse_infill_density win.

layer_height.description: Layer height in mm, such as 0.28 (draft), 0.2 (standard) or 0.12 (fine). Written as the process preset's layer_height over the machine and process preset this tool resolves; at most the nozzle diameter. Bambu-compatible slicers only.

wall_loops.description: Number of walls (perimeters), written as the process preset's wall_loops. Bambu-compatible slicers only.

sparse_infill_density.description: Sparse infill density as a percentage, such as "15%", written as the process preset's sparse_infill_density. Bambu-compatible slicers only.

enable_support.description: Turn support generation on or off, written as the process preset's enable_support. Bambu-compatible slicers only.

support_type.description: Support style, written as the process preset's support_type. Bambu-compatible slicers only.

support_threshold_angle.description: Overhang threshold in degrees for automatic supports, written as the process preset's support_threshold_angle (0 lets the slicer decide). Bambu-compatible slicers only.

tools.name: list_printer_files
tools.description: List files stored on the Bambu Lab printer

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: bambu_connect_import_file
tools.description: Open an existing G-code or sliced 3MF file in the signed-in Bambu Connect app through its official URL scheme. This is a cloud-mode handoff and does not start printing by itself.

file_path.description: Readable local path to a .gcode, .3mf, or .gcode.3mf file

name.description: Optional project name shown by Bambu Connect

version.description: Optional integration version sent to Bambu Connect (default: 1.0.0)

tools.name: bambu_network_bridge_status
tools.description: Inspect or probe the FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab BambuNetwork bridge runtime used for cloud and restored BambuNetwork printing.

connect.description: When true, start the bridge command and run a handshake plus agent initialization probe.

bridge_command.description: Override command for the FULU bridge host or macOS/WSL wrapper; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_BRIDGE_COMMAND. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

bambu_network_config_dir.description: Config/log directory used by the BambuNetwork agent; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_CONFIG_DIR or a user config directory.

country_code.description: BambuNetwork country code, such as US, used by the agent during startup.

user_info.description: Optional BambuNetwork user_info JSON string to pass to net.change_user after the agent starts.

timeout_ms.description: Bridge request timeout in milliseconds for the connect probe.

tools.name: bambu_network_call
tools.description: Call a raw FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab BambuNetwork bridge method, optionally with an initialized network agent injected into the payload.

method.description: FULU bridge method name, for example bridge.handshake, net.is_user_login, or net.get_user_selected_machine.

payload.description: JSON payload passed to the bridge method.

with_agent.description: When true, initialize a BambuNetwork agent and add its agent id to the payload before calling the method.

bridge_command.description: Override command for the FULU bridge host or macOS/WSL wrapper; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_BRIDGE_COMMAND. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

bambu_network_config_dir.description: Config/log directory used by the BambuNetwork agent; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_CONFIG_DIR or a user config directory.

country_code.description: BambuNetwork country code, such as US, used by the agent during startup.

user_info.description: Optional BambuNetwork user_info JSON string to pass to net.change_user after the agent starts.

tools.name: print_3mf_bambu_network
tools.description: Print a 3MF through FULU OrcaSlicer-bambulab's restored BambuNetwork path instead of the MCP LAN MQTT/FTPS path.

three_mf_path.description: Path to the 3MF file to print; unsliced 3MFs are auto-sliced before sending.

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Using the wrong model can damage the printer.

connection_type.description: BambuNetwork connection type to put in FULU PrintParams; cloud uses restored internet printing, lan uses local bridge printing.

bambu_network_method.description: FULU print method to invoke; defaults to start_local_print for lan, and for cloud to Bambu Studio's order: start_local_print_with_record, then start_print if that fails.

dev_id.description: Bambu device id used by BambuNetwork; defaults to BAMBU_DEV_ID or BAMBU_SERIAL.

dev_ip.description: Printer IP address for LAN/local bridge methods; defaults to host when provided.

host.description: Printer host or IP address, used as dev_ip for LAN/local bridge methods.

bambu_serial.description: Fallback Bambu device id when dev_id is not supplied.

bambu_token.description: Printer access code/password for LAN/local bridge methods.

username.description: Printer username for LAN/local bridge methods; defaults to bblp.

password.description: Printer password/access code override for LAN/local bridge methods.

bed_type.description: Bed plate type currently installed (default: textured_plate).

nozzle_type.description: Installed nozzle material, used when the 3MF must be auto-sliced (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the preset's stock nozzle).

nozzle_volume_type.description: Installed nozzle flow type, used when the 3MF must be auto-sliced (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_VOLUME_TYPE, else standard).

plate_index.description: Zero-based plate index to print from the sliced 3MF; converted to FULU's one-based PrintParams plate_index.

project_name.description: Optional project name returned in the result; defaults to the 3MF filename without extension. The printer job and stored file use the server's unique checked name so resume_print can bind to the inspected file.

preset_name.description: Optional preset name sent in FULU PrintParams; defaults to project plus one-based plate index.

task_name.description: Optional project label when project_name is omitted. The submitted task name uses a unique inspected-job identity for safe resume.

config_filename.description: Optional config 3MF path for cloud print; defaults to the same 3MF path.

bridge_command.description: Override command for the FULU bridge host or macOS/WSL wrapper; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_BRIDGE_COMMAND. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

bambu_network_config_dir.description: Config/log directory used by the BambuNetwork agent; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_CONFIG_DIR or a user config directory.

country_code.description: BambuNetwork country code, such as US, used by the agent during startup.

user_info.description: Optional BambuNetwork user_info JSON string to pass to net.change_user after the agent starts.

slicer_type.description: Slicer to use only if auto-slicing an unsliced 3MF; use orcaslicer-bambulab for FULU's fork.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable for auto-slicing; defaults to value from env or a platform default. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

slicer_profile.description: Path to an optional slicer profile/config file for auto-slicing.

nozzle_diameter.description: Nozzle diameter in mm for auto-slicing (default: 0.4).

nozzle_diameters.description: Complete per-nozzle diameters for pre-sliced jobs, e.g. [0.4, 0.6]. Omit to verify file metadata against every reported nozzle; cannot combine with nozzle_diameter.

use_ams.description: Whether to use the AMS; defaults to auto-detect from the 3MF mapping.

ams_mapping.description: AMS slot mapping array used by both local MCP printing and FULU PrintParams. Same tray values as print_3mf: 254 = external spool; on dual-nozzle printers 254 = left/deputy nozzle external and 255 = right/main nozzle external.

ams_slots.description: Per-used-filament AMS slot list, matching the local LAN print path (254/255 external spool rules as in print_3mf).

ams_mapping_bridge.description: Raw JSON string override for FULU PrintParams ams_mapping when the automatic array is not enough.

ams_mapping2.description: Raw JSON string for FULU PrintParams ams_mapping2, matching OrcaSlicer-bambulab's v1 AMS mapping field.

ams_mapping_info.description: Raw JSON string for FULU PrintParams ams_mapping_info, matching OrcaSlicer-bambulab's detailed AMS mapping field.

nozzle_mapping.description: Raw JSON string for FULU PrintParams nozzle_mapping.

nozzles_info.description: Raw JSON string for FULU PrintParams nozzles_info.

bed_leveling.description: Auto bed leveling on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would: the choice saved in BambuStudio.conf for this printer, else Studio's default.

flow_calibration.description: Flow calibration on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would (auto on P1/P1S).

vibration_calibration.description: Vibration calibration (default false, as Bambu Studio sends).

layer_inspect.description: First-layer inspection where supported (default true, as Bambu Studio sends).

timelapse.description: Enable timelapse recording in FULU PrintParams (default: false).

use_ssl_for_ftp.description: Whether FULU local print should use SSL for FTP (default: true).

use_ssl_for_mqtt.description: Whether FULU local print should use SSL for MQTT (default: true).

external_change_assist.description: Enable FULU PrintParams task_ext_change_assist for external filament change assistance.

try_emmc_print.description: Store the job on internal storage (eMMC) instead of the SD card or USB stick. FULU bridge: default false. X2D native printing: omit to use a ready card, else eMMC.

extra_options.description: Raw JSON string or text for FULU PrintParams extra_options.

client_job_id.description: Optional client job id sent to the bridge; defaults to the current timestamp.

tools.name: camera_stream_start
tools.description: Start or renew one persistent camera connection for this printer. Call only while watched; it closes automatically after idle_timeout_ms without a viewer request. camera_snapshot then reuses its latest frame. No printer motion or print commands.

host.description: Printer LAN host or IP; defaults to the configured Bambu host.

bambu_serial.description: Printer serial number; defaults to the configured serial and identifies its shared stream.

bambu_token.description: Printer LAN access code; defaults to the configured access code.

bambu_model.description: Bambu model used to select the camera transport; defaults to BAMBU_MODEL.

fps.description: Maximum processed frames per second. The first viewer sets the rate until the stream closes.

idle_timeout_ms.description: Close the shared connection after this many milliseconds without a viewer request.

tools.name: camera_frame
tools.description: Read the shared camera stream, optionally waiting up to 10 seconds. Returns JPEG only when newer than since_seq and visibly changed (32×18 grayscale difference). Retain the last delivered frame's seq on unchanged. max_width resizes JPEG to the viewer. Does not start a stopped stream.

host.description: Printer LAN host or IP; defaults to the configured Bambu host.

bambu_serial.description: Printer serial number; defaults to the configured serial and identifies its shared stream.

bambu_token.description: Printer LAN access code; defaults to the configured access code.

since_seq.description: Sequence of the last delivered JPEG; retain it when a result is unchanged.

wait_ms.description: Maximum time to await a newer changed frame; zero returns immediately.

max_width.description: Optional maximum JPEG width in pixels, preserving aspect ratio and never enlarging.

max_bytes.description: Optional maximum encoded JPEG bytes. Downscales further at quality 70 when needed; base64 adds about one third plus protocol overhead. Use 42000 for a two-second 30 KB/s viewer budget.

changed_only.description: Return JPEG only when its thumbnail differs enough from the last delivered frame.

min_change.description: Minimum mean absolute grayscale thumbnail difference, normalized from zero to one.

tools.name: camera_stream_stop
tools.description: Close this printer's camera connection and free its cached frames. Other printers keep their own streams. Active viewers may restart it; normally let the idle timeout close a shared stream.

host.description: Printer LAN host or IP; defaults to the configured Bambu host.

bambu_serial.description: Printer serial number; defaults to the configured serial and identifies its shared stream.

bambu_token.description: Printer LAN access code; defaults to the configured access code.

tools.name: camera_snapshot
tools.description: Capture a single JPEG frame from the printer's chamber camera. A1/P1 use TCP-on-6000; X1/P2S/H2/X2D use RTSP via ffmpeg. Returns JPEG as base64; pass save_path to also write the bytes to disk.

save_path.description: Optional absolute path to write the JPEG to disk. If omitted, only the base64 payload is returned.

timeout_ms.description: Max ms to wait for a live frame (default 8000). A1/P1 cameras first replay a buffered frame, which is skipped, so a live frame takes about 3 s, longer on cold start.

bambu_model.description: Printer model. Used to route to the correct protocol or fail fast on unsupported models. Defaults to BAMBU_MODEL.

experimental.description: Deprecated and ignored. Earlier this flag let callers probe H2 series via the A1/P1 TCP-on-6000 path; live testing on an H2S confirmed H2 uses RTSP instead, so the flag has no effect now.

ffmpeg_path.description: Override path to the ffmpeg binary used by the RTSP path. Defaults to FFMPEG_PATH or ffmpeg via $PATH. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1. Required only for the RTSP transport (X1, P2S, H2 series, X2D).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: delete_printer_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the Bambu Lab printer's SD card via FTPS. Destructive: requires confirm:true. Restricted to cache/, timelapse/, and logs/ directories. Path traversal segments (..) are rejected.

filename.description: File to delete. Bare names default to cache/<name>; pass a relative path like timelapse/foo.mp4 to target other allowed directories.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually delete. When false or omitted the call returns without sending an FTP request.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: upload_gcode
tools.description: Inspect a G-code file and upload a uniquely named copy without overwriting existing printer files.

filename.description: Name for the file on the printer

gcode.description: G-code content to upload, or a readable local .gcode path. Required unless gcode_path is provided. For large files, prefer gcode_path.

gcode_path.description: Local path to a .gcode file to upload. Required unless gcode is provided. This avoids sending large G-code bodies through the MCP request.

bambu_model.description: Required printer model for inspecting the uploaded G-code, even when not starting it.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file to the Bambu Lab printer

file_path.description: Local path to the file to upload

filename.description: Name for the file on the printer

connection_mode.description: Upload transport; bambu_native uses the installed Bambu networking plug-in for X2D and never starts printing.

bambu_model.description: Required for every printable .gcode or .3mf upload, including upload-only operations.

project_name.description: Optional project name passed to the native X2D uploader; defaults to filename.

preset_name.description: Optional printer preset name passed to the native X2D uploader.

bed_type.description: Bed plate type for the native X2D uploader (default: textured_plate).

plate_index.description: Zero-based plate index passed to the native X2D uploader (default: 0).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: start_print
tools.description: Start printing a G-code file already on the Bambu Lab printer. Alias of start_print_job for upstream MCP compatibility.

filename.description: Name of the file to print

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Starting G-code for the wrong model can damage the printer.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: start_print_job
tools.description: Start printing a G-code file already on the Bambu Lab printer

filename.description: Name of the file to print

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Starting G-code for the wrong model can damage the printer.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: cancel_print
tools.description: Cancel the current print job on the Bambu Lab printer

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

connection_mode.description: The connection the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE, the same default print_3mf uses, else the model's route.

connection_type.description: FULU BambuNetwork connection type the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE, as for print_3mf. Authenticated controls support lan.

tools.name: pause_print
tools.description: Pause the current print job on the Bambu Lab printer (resumable via resume_print)

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

connection_mode.description: The connection the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE, the same default print_3mf uses, else the model's route.

connection_type.description: FULU BambuNetwork connection type the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE, as for print_3mf. Authenticated controls support lan.

tools.name: resume_print
tools.description: Resume a paused job that this server inspected and started. It re-downloads the job's file over FTPS and compares its SHA-256, asks a person to confirm only when the file could not be re-read, and reads the printer again before sending. A job that was cancelled, ended or replaced is never resumed. Returns jobName and bytesVerified.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

connection_mode.description: The connection the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE, the same default print_3mf uses, else the model's route.

connection_type.description: FULU BambuNetwork connection type the print used. Defaults to BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE, as for print_3mf. Authenticated controls support lan.

tools.name: x2d_native_control
tools.description: Read calibration results or update X2D AMS metadata/calibration selection through the installed plug-in. Raw motion, heating, task control, and safety-setting changes are rejected.

message_json.description: JSON print envelope for ams_filament_setting, extrusion_cali_sel, extrusion_cali_get, extrusion_cali_get_result, or flowrate_get_result. A sequence_id is required; extra fields are rejected.

qos.description: MQTT QoS used by Bambu Studio (0 or 1; default 0).

flag.description: Bambu networking plug-in command flag (0 or 1; default 0).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: clear_hms_errors
tools.description: Clear HMS or print error state on the Bambu Lab printer using the clean_print_error MQTT command.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_print_speed
tools.description: Set the active print speed mode: silent, standard, sport, or ludicrous.

mode.description: Speed mode to apply: silent/1, standard/2, sport/3, or ludicrous/4

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_airduct_mode
tools.description: Set H2/P2 airduct mode to cooling or heating.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: reread_ams_rfid
tools.description: Trigger a Bambu AMS RFID re-read for one AMS slot. X2D on macOS, or Linux with the native helper installed, uses the native official plug-in route. This can move AMS filament; use only when the printer is idle and unloaded.

ams_id.description: AMS unit index from 0 to 3, or 128 for an X2D AMS-HT.

slot_id.description: Slot index within that AMS, from 0 to 3

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_temperature
tools.description: Set a checked bed or nozzle temperature. Positive heating requires matching fresh printer telemetry; nozzle heating also requires declared material. Zero turns the heater off.

component.description: Component to heat: bed, nozzle, or extruder

temperature.description: Finite target temperature in °C, checked against model/component and declared material limits

bambu_model.description: Printer model, required for positive heating unless configured in the environment

material.description: Loaded material, for example PLA or PETG. Required for positive nozzle heating, including non-RFID spools.

nozzle_diameter.description: Installed nozzle diameter to compare with printer-reported configuration (default 0.4)

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set a Bambu printer fan speed percentage. X2D on macOS, or Linux with the native helper installed, uses Bambu's networking plug-in without UI automation; other models use MQTT.

fan.description: Fan to control: part, auxiliary, right_auxiliary, chamber, 1, 2, 3, or 10

confirm_during_print.description: Required for X2D fan changes while a print is running.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_light
tools.description: Set a Bambu printer light node mode using the printer's MQTT LED command

light.description: Light node to control, for example chamber_light

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: skip_objects
tools.description: Skip specific object IDs during a running multi-object print using the printer's MQTT skip_objects command

object_ids.description: Object IDs to skip. Use list_3mf_plate_objects on the sliced 3MF to find IDs.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: set_ams_drying
tools.description: Start or stop the AMS filament drying cycle. X2D on macOS, or Linux with the native helper installed, uses the native official plug-in route and supports AMS-HT id 128.

action.description: Whether to start or stop the drying cycle

ams_id.description: AMS unit index from 0 to 3, or 128 for an X2D AMS-HT.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: inspect_print_file
tools.description: Inspect an exact private snapshot of a prepared sliced 3MF or textual G-code file and selected plate without contacting a printer. Returns versioned file-only evidence; no printer readiness or permission to dispatch is established. Does not auto-slice.

file_path.description: Local prepared .3mf or textual .gcode artifact to inspect; checksum-only and unsliced projects reject.

bambu_model.description: Explicit file-inspection target model; never inferred from environment or live state.

plate_index.description: Zero-based selected plate; defaults to 0. Raw G-code only supports 0.

nozzle_diameters.description: Optional requested nozzle diameters to compare with file declarations; this does not observe installed hardware.

bed_type.description: Optional declared bed type to compare with file metadata.

include_preview.description: Also return preview: PNG pictures drawn from this exact file's G-code (every extruding line in its filament's colour; the top as it sits on the bed, and the bed side turned over), with the artifact's sha256. Large (tens of KB of base64); for apps that show the person what will print, not for agents.

tools.name: print_3mf
tools.description: Print a 3MF file on a Bambu Lab printer. Auto-slices if the 3MF has no gcode. IMPORTANT: bambu_model must be specified to ensure safe printer operation.

three_mf_path.description: Path to the 3MF file to print

pause_at_layers.description: Pause before each of these layers (1-based, as Bambu Studio and OrcaSlicer number them in the preview), for example to drop in magnets or nuts. The slicer writes the printer's own pause G-code there (M400 U1 on Bambu printers); the printer stops by itself and waits for Resume. Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer CLI only. Used when the 3MF has no G-code yet; a sliced 3MF must already carry these pauses, or it is refused.

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. Ask the user if not known. Using the wrong model can damage the printer.

connection_mode.description: Print path: bambu_connect hands a printable file to the signed-in Bambu Connect app for cloud-mode review; X2D otherwise defaults to bambu_native (Bambu Studio's installed local networking plug-in, storing the job on a ready SD card or USB stick, otherwise internal eMMC); lan_mqtt_ftps is the legacy direct MQTT/FTPS path; bambu_network uses the FULU bridge.

try_emmc_print.description: X2D native printing: true stores the job on internal storage (eMMC), false on the SD card or USB stick (refused unless the printer reports one ready). Omit to use the card when ready, else eMMC; BAMBU_NATIVE_TRY_EMMC_PRINT sets a server default.

connection_type.description: BambuNetwork connection type when connection_mode is bambu_network; cloud uses restored internet printing, lan uses local bridge printing.

bambu_network_method.description: FULU print method when connection_mode is bambu_network; defaults to start_local_print for lan, and for cloud to Bambu Studio's order: start_local_print_with_record, then start_print if that fails.

dev_id.description: Bambu device id for FULU BambuNetwork printing; defaults to BAMBU_DEV_ID or BAMBU_SERIAL.

dev_ip.description: Printer IP address for FULU BambuNetwork LAN/local print methods; defaults to host when provided.

bridge_command.description: Override command for the FULU bridge host or macOS/WSL wrapper; defaults to BAMBU_NETWORK_BRIDGE_COMMAND. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

bambu_network_config_dir.description: Config/log directory used by the FULU BambuNetwork agent.

country_code.description: BambuNetwork country code, such as US, used by the FULU bridge agent.

user_info.description: Optional BambuNetwork user_info JSON string passed to net.change_user for the FULU bridge.

bed_type.description: Bed plate type currently installed (default: textured_plate)

nozzle_type.description: Installed nozzle material, used when the 3MF must be auto-sliced (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_TYPE, else the preset's stock nozzle).

nozzle_volume_type.description: Installed nozzle flow type, used when the 3MF must be auto-sliced (default: BAMBU_NOZZLE_VOLUME_TYPE, else standard).

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

plate_index.description: Zero-based plate index to print from the sliced 3MF (default: 0)

slicer_type.description: Slicer to use only if auto-slicing an unsliced 3MF. Bambu-compatible slicer aliases such as fulu-orca and orca-studio are accepted.

slicer_path.description: Path to the slicer executable for auto-slicing (default: value from env or a platform default). Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

use_ams.description: Whether to use the AMS (default: auto-detect from 3MF)

ams_mapping.description: Project-level AMS mapping array. Position = project filament index, value = absolute AMS tray (0-3=AMS 0, 4-7=AMS 1, 8-11=AMS 2, 128+=AMS-HT, 254=external, -1=unused). On dual-nozzle printers (H2D, H2D Pro, H2C, X2D) 254 is the LEFT/deputy nozzle external spool and 255 the RIGHT/main nozzle external spool, matching Bambu Studio's virtual tray ids; the gcode header's filament_map (1=left, 2=right) says which nozzle each filament was sliced for. Prefer ams_slots unless you know the project-level layout.

ams_slots.description: Preferred AMS input: one absolute tray index per USED filament in plate order, e.g. [1] for a single-filament print pulling from AMS 0 slot 1. Use 254 for the external spool (on dual-nozzle printers: 254 = left/deputy nozzle external, 255 = right/main nozzle external). Expanded to project-level ams_mapping automatically from the 3MF's plate_N.json and gcode header.

auto_match_ams.description: When true, match the sliced 3MF's tray_info_idx requirements against live AMS inventory and use the resulting ams_slots. Ignored when ams_mapping or ams_slots is provided.

bed_leveling.description: Auto bed leveling on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would: the choice saved in BambuStudio.conf for this printer, else Studio's default.

flow_calibration.description: Flow calibration on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would (auto on P1/P1S).

vibration_calibration.description: Vibration calibration (default false, as Bambu Studio sends).

slicer_profile.description: Path to the slicer profile/config file for auto-slicing (optional).

template_3mf_path.description: Optional template 3MF whose embedded Bambu slicer settings should be reused when auto-slicing this print job.

template_name.description: Optional named template from the local registry. Resolves to template_3mf_path automatically.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override when resolving template_name.

nozzle_diameter.description: Nozzle diameter in mm for auto-slicing (default: 0.4)

nozzle_diameters.description: Complete per-nozzle diameters for a pre-sliced job, e.g. [0.4, 0.6]. Omit to verify its declared diameters against live telemetry; cannot combine with nozzle_diameter.

tools.name: print_collar_charm
tools.description: Print a prepared two-part dog collar charm project using the fixed tray policy: inner/smaller object -> black on AMS 1 slot 1, outer/larger object -> white on AMS 2 slot 1.

source_path.description: Path to a prepared collar charm .3mf project or sliced 3MF. Required unless template_name is provided.

template_name.description: Named collar charm template from the local registry. Required unless source_path is provided; resolves source_path automatically.

template_dir.description: Optional template directory override when resolving template_name.

bambu_model.description: REQUIRED: Bambu Lab printer model. H2D, H2S, and H2C are the primary intended paths. X2D direct printing is not supported.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

bed_type.description: Bed plate type currently installed (default: textured_plate)

bed_leveling.description: Auto bed leveling on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would: the choice saved in BambuStudio.conf for this printer, else Studio's default.

flow_calibration.description: Flow calibration on or off. Omit to send what Bambu Studio's Send dialog would (auto on P1/P1S).

vibration_calibration.description: Vibration calibration (default false, as Bambu Studio sends).

slicer_profile.description: Path to the slicer profile/config file for auto-slicing (optional).

nozzle_diameter.description: Nozzle diameter in mm for auto-slicing (default: 0.4)

tools.name: merge_vertices
tools.description: Merge vertices in an STL file closer than the specified tolerance

tools.name: center_model
tools.description: Translate the model so its geometric center is at the origin (0,0,0)

tools.name: lay_flat
tools.description: Rotate the model so a face rests on the bed (Z=0), choosing the orientation with the least part and support volume per mm² of bed contact. A face counts only if nothing hangs below it. Returns the new STL path; structuredContent.laid_flat is false, with the input path, when no orientation qualifies.

tools.name: blender_mcp_status
tools.description: Inspect Blender MCP configuration or connect and discover the remote server's tools and schemas. Connecting does not edit the scene; use get_scene_info through blender_mcp_call to check the Blender addon.

connect.description: Initialize the configured stdio MCP server and discover its tools (default false).

timeout_ms.description: Total connection and discovery deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

tools.name: blender_mcp_call
tools.description: Call a discovered tool on the configured Blender MCP server, preserving its full MCP content and errors. Discover tool schemas with blender_mcp_status first; execute_blender_code accepts Python code and user_prompt. Calls can modify the active Blender scene and are never automatically retried.

tool_name.description: Exact name advertised by Blender MCP, such as get_scene_info or execute_blender_code.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the remote tool's discovered input schema. Preserve the user's own words in user_prompt when the remote tool requests it.

timeout_ms.description: Total connection, discovery, and tool deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

tools.name: blender_mcp_edit_model
tools.description: Import, edit, and export a local STL through standard Blender MCP with verified output and existing scene objects preserved. Requires a shared local filesystem and Blender Object Mode. Also supports a separately configured legacy executable bridge.

stl_path.description: Path to the local STL file

operations.description: Ordered operations: decimate:<ratio greater than 0 and at most 1>, remesh:<positive voxel size in STL units>, boolean_union:<STL path>. Legacy custom bridges define their own operations.

output_path.description: Required for standard MCP previews and execution: new local STL output path whose parent exists. Existing files are never overwritten. Optional for legacy-only bridge configuration.

user_prompt.description: The user's own words describing the edit, passed unchanged to Blender MCP.

timeout_ms.description: Total Blender request deadline in milliseconds; defaults to BLENDER_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 120000.

bridge_command.description: Legacy custom bridge executable override, not a standard MCP command. Per-call overrides require MCP_ALLOW_EXECUTABLE_ARG=1.

execute.description: Apply edits and export (true) or validate and return the prepared request without connecting (false, default).

tools.name: counterpart_printer_info
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): this server's name and version, the configured Bambu printer, and which progress, layer, camera, filament, pause/resume/cancel and print features it has. Sends nothing to the printer.

bambu_model.description: Printer model; defaults to BAMBU_MODEL. Selects the camera transport.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

bambu_token.description: Access token (default: value from env); never returned.

tools.name: counterpart_discover_printers
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): Bambu printers on the local network, from their own SSDP announcements (UDP 2021), with serial, model (as bambu_model names it), name and firmware. Listens for duration_ms (default 4000). network is "unavailable" when another app holds the port. Never connects to or authenticates with a printer.

tools.name: counterpart_setup_fields
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): the printers this server drives and the settings it reads for each, by .env variable name (first canonical, then aliases): label, hint, whether required, the model choices and the model each serial-number prefix names. Pass serial to get the model it names. Sends nothing to a printer and returns no configured values.

serial.description: A Bambu serial number: model is the one it names, when known.

tools.name: counterpart_propose_filaments
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): which loaded AMS spool prints each of a model's colours, before slicing. Reads the live AMS once. trays lists the spools a person may choose (label like "A2", a person-readable name, colour, material, feed). proposal gives each filament its nearest spool in OKLab colour with the asked-for material preferred, and a verdict: same-colour, closest (that colour isn't loaded; note says so), no-colour or none. One print feeds from one source. Pass chosen to check the person's spools against what is loaded now; mapping then lists every filament slot's spool (painted slots included), and problems says why a choice can't print.

filaments.description: The model's filaments a person sees, in project order: 1-based index, part name, the colour it belongs in and its material when known.

painted.description: Filament slots no part names (painted regions). Each follows the chosen spools' feed; prints false when the selected plate never uses it.

chosen.description: The person's spool for each filament, in the same order: checked against what is loaded now. Omit for the proposal alone.

sliced.description: The file is already sliced: its materials are fixed, so only spools of the same material qualify.

bambu_model.description: Printer model; defaults to BAMBU_MODEL. Selects the filament profiles that decide which spools can slice.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

bambu_token.description: Access token (default: value from env); never returned.

tools.name: counterpart_print_route
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): how this server reaches the printer for prints and for Stop/Pause/Resume. route is "lan" (the local network through FULU's BambuNetwork bridge, or the configured X2D native or Bambu Connect mode), "cloud" (Bambu Cloud through FULU's bridge) or "developer" (the local network straight to a printer in LAN Only + Developer Mode, whose Pause, Resume and Stop need no Bambu app). options lists each with its label, whether it can be chosen here (and why not) and what controls do on it; choices lists the ids that can be chosen. mode and type are BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_MODE and BAMBU_DEFAULT_CONNECTION_TYPE as resolved. Pass route to change it: the change applies to the next print and control at once, and is saved to the .env file in this server's working directory when that file exists (savedTo; null otherwise). Sends nothing to the printer.

route.description: Change the route. Omit to read it.

tools.name: counterpart_print_progress
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): the printer's state, current job (name, task id, percent, time left, layers, stage words), temperatures, active filament and problems with Bambu's HMS messages and links. Read from the MQTT report this server keeps, so a held session asks the printer nothing; observedAt is when the printer sent it. An unreachable printer reports state offline. Read-only; not a safety check.

bambu_model.description: Printer model; defaults to BAMBU_MODEL. Used for the chamber sensor and Bambu's per-model messages.

host.description: Hostname or IP of the printer (default: value from env)

tools.name: counterpart_make_3mf
tools.description: Counterpart contract (counterpart/1): combine STL parts exported separately (for example each body of a design) into one new 3MF for multi-colour printing. The parts keep their relative positions as one assembly, and each part prints with its filament number (default: part 1 uses filament 1, part 2 filament 2, and so on). Slice it with slice_stl, passing one load_filaments profile per filament number, then print it with print_3mf and ams_mapping or ams_slots. Never overwrites a file.

stl_path.description: Path to the part's STL file.

name.description: The part's name, shown in the slicer.

filament.description: 1-based project filament for this part; defaults to the part's position (1, 2, ...).

out_path.description: New .3mf path whose parent directory exists. Existing files are never overwritten.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_status
tools.description: Check Autodesk Fusion through the configured Fusion MCP server (faust-machines/fusion360-mcp-server): whether it is configured, Fusion is running, the Fusion360MCP add-in answers on its port, and the server's tools and schemas. connected is true only when the add-in answers. With launch: true, starts Fusion on macOS when it is not running and waits up to 90 s for the add-in. Configure FUSION_MCP_COMMAND (uvx) and FUSION_MCP_ARGS (["--from","git+https://github.com/faust-machines/fusion360-mcp-server@19b9f1e95192","fusion360-mcp-server","--mode","socket"]).

launch.description: Start Autodesk Fusion (open -a "Autodesk Fusion") when it is not running, then wait up to 90 s for the add-in.

timeout_ms.description: Connection and discovery deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_call
tools.description: Call a discovered tool on the configured Fusion MCP server, such as create_sketch, extrude, fillet, create_parameter, set_parameter, check_interference or execute_code, preserving its full MCP content and errors. Discover tool schemas with fusion_mcp_status first. Calls change the open Fusion design and are never automatically retried. Most tools need an open design: call fusion_mcp_new_design first.

document_id.description: Session identity returned by a bound new design. Every operation targets this document, even if the user changes tabs.

tool_name.description: Exact tool name advertised by the Fusion MCP server.

arguments.description: Arguments matching the remote tool's discovered input schema.

timeout_ms.description: Total deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_new_design
tools.description: Open a new parametric design document in Fusion (execute_code with app.documents.add(FusionDesignDocumentType)). The Fusion MCP tools work on the open design, so a design pass calls this first.

bind_document.description: Create an isolated document and return its session identity, restoring the previously active document. Requires document-binding support in the configured bridge/add-in.

source_f3d.description: With bind_document, import this absolute F3D path into a new document for revision.

timeout_ms.description: Total deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

tools.name: fusion_mcp_export
tools.description: Export the open Fusion design into an existing directory as <name>.stl (export_stl of one body), <name>.f3d (export_f3d) and <name>.parameters.json (its user parameters), and return their absolute paths. The STL is checked as a finite triangle mesh; slice it like any other model. Fusion must run on this computer, and existing files are never overwritten.

document_id.description: Session identity returned by a bound new design. Every operation targets this document, even if the user changes tabs.

output_dir.description: Existing directory for the three files.

name.description: File name without extension, such as bracket.

body_name.description: The body to export as STL. Optional when the design has exactly one body.

timeout_ms.description: Total deadline in milliseconds; defaults to FUSION_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS or 180000.

instructions: When designing or editing a model to print, apply the fdm_design prompt. Add fdm_multicolor when several colours or support materials share a print, fdm_assembly when a split or joint could help, and fdm_after_slice as a separate review turn after a candidate has been sliced, before presenting the manufacturing recommendation. Read guidance://fdm/capability-guidance when a bridge or overhang is consequential and there is no sufficiently specific measured capability available.
